C0040.title: Minor Sentenced for Online Store Fraud via Fake Shipments
C0040.summary: On May 15, 2025, Jiangxi Yongxin County People’s Court heard a juvenile online-shop fraud case. Wang created a steel-pipe materials shop on a shopping app, sent fake shipping documents and product photos, induced the victim to pay an RMB 8,800 deposit, and did not actually deliver the goods. Considering the circumstances, remorse, and Wang’s age at the time of the offense, the court found fraud and sentenced Wang to eight months in prison, suspended for one year, and an RMB 2,000 fine.
